title: Managed Database: primary usage unit
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database primary usage unit is specified by contracted tier. Primary meter quantity unit; string. Primary meter quantity included per holding per complete month, prorated by active seconds; decimal. Smallest billable primary meter increment in primary usage unit; positive decimal. Minimum primary quantity billed per measured resource interval; decimal. Treatment of usage exceeding included allowance; string.
